name: Summer Passion
storyline:
Margaret thought her birthday celebration with her girlfriend Arabelle would be simple—sun, laughter, and maybe a few stolen kisses by the beach. But things take a thrilling turn when Arabelle reveals her real birthday surprise: Morgan, a world-class surfer with magnetic charm and a body sculpted by waves.

From the moment their eyes meet, Margaret feels a flutter in her chest—a rush she hasn’t felt since falling for Arabelle. It’s confusing, it’s thrilling... it feels like falling in love for the very first time all over again.
summary: Summer Passion is a cozy visual novel set on a secluded island where flirty encounters bloom in the heat of summer. Join Margaret on her laid-back adventure, where playful surprises await. With stunning visuals and spicy scenes, this tropical escape is everything you need.
